notes: Solar helioscope search for dark photons via kinetic mixing using Hinode X-Ray Telescope darks and eclipse data. This is a production-based (not DM haloscope) bound, so no DM density assumed. Data points are approximate values read from exclusion plot (figure 5/8) for the optimistic darks analysis; specific benchmark points (m=15 eV, eps=1.2e-10; m=400 eV, eps=6.1e-11; m=1 eV) are quoted in text and table. Values are approximate as no numerical table of the exclusion curve was provided; the curve shows resonant bump structure around 5-300 eV and kink at low mass. Table 1 gives sensitivity at m=1 eV ~1e-9 for darks. | selector: text (sole candidate)
